Report formats

The same investigation rendered in each format: whether a two-person startup should self-host Firecracker sandboxes on Hetzner or rent E2B / Modal. Open one to try its navigation, depth and controls. To get a format, name it when you ask for a report, or reply with its name after the AI announces its pick.

If the report is mostly…Use
an argument to read top to bottom (the default)Longread
for readers who each want a different depth, with derivations and formal rigourWorking Paper
a model the reader should audit and re-runNotebook
a live decision model with many linked numbersCockpit
about when: growth thresholds, dated events, phasesGrowth Roadmap
about how parts of a system relateBlueprint
a landscape of distinct areas to explore in any orderThe Atlas
    {{CARDS}}
Examples are illustrations of the formats. Their numbers come from a real investigation dated 2026-10-18.
